screening_decisions.reason: RCT in adults with frozen shoulder comparing mobilisation (manual therapy) plus pendular exercises to steroid injection, ice therapy, and no treatment. Addresses manual therapy/exercise against other interventions.
Observational incidence study in general practice, not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
Educational article on joint mobilization principles, not a clinical trial.

Open RCT comparing physical therapies (including therapeutic exercises) alone vs physical therapies plus arthrographic distension with steroid for frozen shoulder. Relevant exercise intervention comparison.
Methodological study on protocol and registry reporting, not a clinical trial.
RCT evaluating deep transverse friction massage (manual therapy) and capsular stretching (exercise) in idiopathic adhesive capsulitis.
RCT comparing two different exercise programs (glenohumeral ROM exercises vs ROM plus scapulothoracic exercises) in frozen shoulder, meeting criteria for different types of exercise.
Randomized multiple-treatment trial comparing three mobilization techniques (end-range, mid-range, MWM) in frozen shoulder syndrome.

Comparative study of PNF movement patterns vs conventional free exercises in chronic peri-arthritis of the shoulder; randomisation not explicit but population and interventions relevant; include conservatively.
RCT comparing antero-posterior vs postero-anterior glides (manual therapy) on external rotation ROM in adhesive capsulitis.
Cross-sectional prevalence survey of upper limb musculoskeletal disorders, not a trial.
Multiple-subject case report (n=7) without control group; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.

Placebo-controlled RCT comparing intraarticular corticosteroid, supervised physiotherapy (likely including manual therapy and exercise), or combination in adhesive capsulitis. Relevant to manual therapy/exercise.
RCT assessing manual therapy and directed exercise vs placebo (sham ultrasound) after joint distension for adhesive capsulitis. Directly addresses manual therapy plus exercise.
Observational study on responsiveness of a disability questionnaire, not an intervention trial.
Non-randomised comparative study of physical therapy, acupuncture, and combination for frozen shoulder; not an RCT/quasi-randomised trial.
Systematic review and cost-effectiveness analysis, not a primary RCT.
Comparative study of anterior vs posterior glide mobilisation for internal rotation ROM in adhesive capsulitis; randomisation not stated but population/intervention relevant; included conservatively.
Study on outcome reporting bias and meta-analysis, not a clinical trial in adhesive capsulitis.
Title suggests frozen shoulder but abstract describes a cohort study of multiple sclerosis patients; population and design do not meet protocol criteria.
RCT comparing corticosteroid injections, physiotherapy (including manual therapy/exercise), and combination therapy in frozen shoulder. Relevant intervention comparisons.
RCT comparing Cyriax method (deep friction massage and mobilisation exercises) vs conventional physical therapy (hot pack, diathermy, exercises) in adhesive capsulitis.
Prospective observational follow-up study on natural history of frozen shoulder, no intervention.
Methodological article on quantifying heterogeneity in meta-analysis, not a clinical trial.
Book chapter on reporting biases, not a clinical trial.
This is a prospective long-term follow-up study with no randomized comparison. It does not meet the inclusion criteria for RCTs or quasi-randomised trials.

RCT: patients with painful glenohumeral restrictions (adhesive capsulitis) randomized to passive mobilization + active exercises vs active exercises alone. Matches intervention (manual therapy + exercise) and population.

RCT in adhesive capsulitis comparing intraarticular hyaluronate injection, steroid injection, physical therapy, and control. Physical therapy arm may include exercise/mobilization; relevant as a comparison of physical therapy (which likely contains exercise) against other interventions. Include conservatively.

EMG study evaluating muscle activity during exercises in subjects with shoulder pain (not specifically adhesive capsulitis). Not a clinical trial of an intervention; no randomized comparison of manual therapy or exercise against a control.

Study compares suprascapular nerve block, corticosteroid injection, and physiotherapy for chronic shoulder pain, not specifically adhesive capsulitis. Population not clearly defined as frozen shoulder and lack of focus on manual therapy/exercise per se.
RCT in adhesive capsulitis comparing local steroid injection vs physical therapy (which typically includes exercise). Addresses manual therapy/exercise indirectly.
This is a methodology chapter from a textbook (Cochrane Handbook) about interpreting results; not an original study.
Retrospective study design, not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
RCT comparing Mulligan's vs Maitland's mobilization techniques in adhesive capsulitis. Both are manual therapy interventions, fitting the review scope.
Book chapter on presenting results (Cochrane Handbook); not an original study.
Population-based epidemiological study of consultation patterns; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial of an intervention.
RCT comparing iontophoresis and phonophoresis (electrophysical agents) for shoulder periarthritis. These are not manual therapy or exercise interventions.
Prospective randomised observer-blind trial comparing local steroid injection, physiotherapy, or both in painful stiff shoulder. Physiotherapy is likely to involve exercise/manual therapy.

RCT of electroacupuncture + exercise vs interferential electrotherapy + exercise vs no treatment for frozen shoulder. Although exercise is included in both arms, the study primarily assesses electrical modalities, not manual therapy. Does not address manual therapy effects.
RCT comparing ibuprofen alone vs ibuprofen + a combined physical therapy technique in adhesive capsulitis. Physical therapy likely includes manual therapy/exercise.
RCT comparing exercises + ultrasound vs exercises + ultrasound + end-range mobilization in adhesive capsulitis. Addresses manual therapy (mobilization) added to exercise.
RCT comparing anterior vs posterior glide mobilization in adhesive capsulitis, both with ultrasound and exercise. Manual therapy comparison.
RCT with factorial design comparing corticosteroid injection and physiotherapy (including home exercise) in adhesive capsulitis. Evaluates manual therapy/exercise as part of physiotherapy.
Prospective randomised trial comparing manipulation under anaesthesia, peri-articular injection, and physiotherapy for adhesive capsulitis. Includes manual therapy/exercise arm.
This is a systematic review, not an original RCT or quasi-randomised trial. The protocol only includes primary studies.
Book chapter on meta-analysis methods (Cochrane Handbook); not an original study.

Described as a randomized controlled study but the abstract reports a prospective investigation of predictors (age, gender, frequency, compliance) rather than a randomized comparison of manual therapy vs control. Does not clearly evaluate manual therapy or exercise as an intervention effect.

Prospective, systematically allocated clinical trial (quasi-randomised) comparing chiropractic manipulation + exercise vs mobilization + exercise in adhesive capsulitis. Both arms include manual therapy and exercise.
RCT comparing high-grade vs low-grade mobilization techniques in adhesive capsulitis. Both are manual therapy interventions.
Pilot RCT examining whether passive mobilisation added to a home-care programme after corticosteroid injection improves outcomes in adhesive capsulitis. Addresses manual therapy adjunct effect.
